svg.title: Live from the Embankment: London skyline of GitHub contributions for mdtarek-islam
svg.desc: Night skyline of London over the Thames Embankment for mdtarek-islam. Silhouettes of the London Eye, St Paul's Cathedral, the Gherkin, Tower Bridge and the Shard stand behind 52 buildings, one per week. Height scales with the weekly contribution count. Seven windows per building show the days, Sunday at the top, brighter for busier days. 9 Nov 2025 to 3 Nov 2026: 136 contributions in 52 weeks, includes private contributions. Activity breakdown: 81 commits, 0 code reviews, 2 pull requests, 0 issues, 15 new repositories, 37 private. Peak week of 1 Nov 2026: 73.
svg.text: One building per week, one window per day
